EdgeWave_SAM: Hey @sabrina_cse — we're ready to onboard our summarization model to Redwood Private. Need HSM + PHI handling. Can you kick off intake?
Sabrina CSE: Thanks! Tagging eng and security. Quick Q: model size, preferred artifact format, and must-haves for PHI handling?
Alex (Solutions): cc @Priya (Security) @Marco (ML Eng). Is this on-prem or VPC? Also real-time low-latency or batch?
EdgeWave_SAM: On-prem appliance initially, real-time low-latency target. Model is ~13B (float32), customer is open to 4/8-bit quant. Requires FIPS-compatible HSM for key material and audit logs.
Priya (Security): We need a simple dataflow diagram and examples of expected PHI types. Also retention and dedupe rules. Please include any third-party vendor links.
Marco (ML Eng): For a 13B at 8k context, we'll likely recommend q4f16 + KV cache pinning. Can you share a small eval set (50–100 examples) and p50/p90 perf targets?
EdgeWave_SAM: Uploading an anonymized eval set to s3://edgewave/redwood-intake. Contains transcripts with PHI markers and expected outputs. Perf goal: p50 < 300ms, p90 < 600ms. Cost is secondary.
Sabrina CSE: OK — I'll open the intake ticket and sequence the items: security intake, artifact validation, perf eval, dedicated capacity estimate, and enablement plan. Who can own the eval?
Marco (ML Eng): I'll own the first eval run. Need the HF model artifact (or pt), tokenizer files, and a handful of prompt templates. Also any special compiler flags they want preserved.
EdgeWave_SAM: We'll provide HF tarball + tokenizer.json and prompt templates in the S3 folder. Client requires HSM integration for key unwrap during private deploy; they will provide endpoint and certs during install.
Alex (Solutions): I'll draft a capacity and pricing estimate for dedicated on-prem capacity and a canary rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Also note we should plan for a fallback to hosted smaller model if latency/SLA fails.
Priya (Security): Add to checklist: TLS mutual auth, HSM attestation, key rotation quarterly, audit log retention 12 months, and privacy SLA clause. Also need a pointer to their SOC2 report.
Sabrina CSE: Filing intake ticket now (CS-7592) and scheduling a 30m intake call with EdgeWave for Thu 11:00 PT. I'll assign Marco for eval and Alex for deployment plan.
EdgeWave_SAM: Thu 11:00 PT works for us — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Ticket CS-7592 created by Sabrina CSE — artifacts linked: s3://edgewave/redwood-intake
Marco (ML Eng): I'll kick off the eval on Monday and post perf logs and any safety flags here. If perf is worse than expected we'll try progressive quantization + autobatching.
Sabrina CSE: Please capture any prompt-level failures and hallucinations. EdgeWave: if you see PHI leakage or unexpected outputs, escalate to me immediately.
EdgeWave_SAM: Understood. We'll join the call and be available during the eval runs. Thanks all!
